what: Under the sideways-swipe photo strip (browser default horizontal scroll · snaps per item), a 2px progress bar starts already filled to 150px, and the remaining length extends over .25s ease by the proportion the strip has been moved. The previous/next arrows smoothly move one photo width (290px) at a time, and on hover each nudges 3px in its own direction (.2s ease)

options.start: Initial filled bar length (px), default 150 — if longer than the bar track, the track length
options.step: Distance pushed per arrow click (px), default 290 (one photo + gap) — the Brand product row is 400
options.[data-fx-part=strip]: Horizontally overflowing strip — first child is the photo row (flex), grandchild is a photo cell
options.[data-fx-part=track] > [data-fx-part=bar: (If present) bar track and the filling bar
options.--fx-track·--fx-fill·--fx-height: Bar background color · bar color · thickness (via style), default --kf-surface · --kf-ink · 2px
options.--fx-dur·--fx-ease: Bar growth duration · curve (via style), default .25s · ease
options.--fx-snap: Attached per section (via style), default x mandatory — with none it stops freely (brand PC) — brand is also none
options.--fx-nudge: Distance the arrow steps aside (via style), default 3px

note: Dragging is just the browser’s native horizontal scroll, so it doesn’t hijack touch (swiping vertically scrolls the page)

from.where: index.html .eb-gallery (vertical photo strip beside About — original script.js Gallery scroll progress: initFill 150, STEP 290 scrollBy smooth, bar width .25s ease, arrow hover translateX ±.3 unit .2s ease, phone uses scroll-snap x mandatory)
index.html .bu-all (horizontal product row of all umbrellas — original scrollBy 400 smooth, no bar · snapping · nudging: step: 400 · --fx-snap: none · --fx-nudge: 0px)
